resources.string: Changes flow in both directions. Simultaneous edits keep both versions. A saved baseline and valid checksums are required before scheduled runs can start.

string-array.item: Prefer local files when contents differ
Prefer remote files when contents differ

resources.string: Initialisation combines both folders. Files present on only one side are copied. When both sides contain different versions, the selected side overwrites the other. This is separate from normal conflict handling.
A normal run stops if a side exceeds this percentage of deletions. This does not limit overwrites during initialisation. Set up backups for important data.
Require access markers in both folders
Create a file named RCLONE_TEST in each folder before enabling this. A missing marker stops the run. Markers are never created or bypassed automatically.
Backup folders must be outside the synchronised folders. The remote backup must use the same remote, for example proton:Backups. Local backups contain readable file contents.
Use one --flag or --flag=value per line. Spaces in values do not need quotes. Credentials belong in the remote editor. The bundled engine checks option names and values before running.

Preview captured: %1$s
This is the saved advisory report, not a fresh scan or approval. Settings and remote contents may have changed.

%2$s

Preview is a dry run and does not transfer or delete files. Ready tasks preview normal changes without altering their baseline. New or changed tasks preview initialisation and require approval within 30 minutes. A preview may refresh credentials and is not a snapshot of cloud contents.
Check the preview below and your backups. Initialisation can overwrite differing files according to the selected preference. Remote contents may change after this preview.\n\n%1$s
